register.reg_long_name: Branch Record Buffer Target Address Injection Register

purpose_text.para: The target address of a Branch record for injection.

field_description.para: Target virtual address of the Branch record.
When a direct write occurs with a value with ADDRESS bits [63:P] indicating an invalid address, an UNKNOWN value which indicates an invalid address is written to bits [63:P].

listitem.content: For an address in a translation regime with 2 VA ranges, with bits [63:P] not all zeros or all ones.
For an address in a translation regime with a single VA range, with bits [63:P] not all zeros.

field_description.para: The value in bits [P-1:0] is the value written.
When a direct write occurs with a value with ADDRESS bits [63:P] indicating a valid address, the written value is written to bits [63:0], and a read of the register returns the written value.
